content: When creating a new disease page, you should begin by typing `__NOTOC__` at the very top of the edit box. Following this, you should include the microchapter template that you have created for the specific disease. For example, if the disease is jaundice, you would type `{{Jaundice}}` into the edit box. Next, you need to create a link to the patient information page on the main disease page. For instance, if the disease is pericarditis, you would type the following into the edit box: `'''For patient information, click [link]'''`. This will appear on the page as a bolded statement: For patient information, click here. The square brackets are used to create the hyperlink. On the left side of the vertical bar within the square brackets, you should include the page you are linking to, and on the right side, you should include the text you want to display on the page. After this, you should include the template for the Editor-in-Chief, Dr. C. Michael Gibson, by typing `{{CMG}}` into the edit box. The curly brackets around CMG are required. On the page, this will appear as: Editor-In-Chief: C. Michael Gibson, M.S., M.D. Subsequently, you should type `{{AE}}` into the edit box. This will display on the page as: Associate Editor(s)-in-Chief:. After this, you should include your own user template, which links to your user page. To create your name template, follow these steps: Your name template will link to your user page, allowing readers to learn more about you. You should already have a user page, which was created when you first logged into WikiDoc. If you need instructions on creating a user page, you can find them by clicking the appropriate link. To create your name template, type Template:your initials into the search box. For example, if your name is John Doe, you would search for Template:JD. In the edit box, you would type `[link]`. On the left side of the vertical line within the square brackets, include the link to your user page. On the right side of the vertical line, include the text you want to display as your name. Once you have completed this, click Save. From then on, whenever John Doe, M.D., wants his name to appear at the top of a page with a link to his user page, he would simply type `{{JD}}`. For example, if John Doe is creating a page on jaundice, the edit box would look like this: `__NOTOC__ {{Jaundice}}` This would appear at the top of the page as such. After this, you should add a line for synonyms and keywords related to the disease, if applicable. This process is detailed further in the next section of the main help page.
